commit.author: Timo Sulg <timgluz@gmail.com>

changes.title: feat(web): mark instances and solvers that have published results on the index pages

commit.message:
Queue markers for the instances and solvers that have published results

The index pages list 111 instances and 21 solvers without saying which have results,
while /bench/v2/ publishes 12 instances and 22 solver shards. Records the design: the
manifest is the only honest source (bench/matrix/tier-a.toml is intent, and a shard can
answer 200 after being retired), the pages stay server-rendered, and one script per page
badges the rows the manifest names — with no badges at all if it cannot be read.
